verdict: Leads are coming in cheap, but none are reaching your pipeline yet.
narrative: You received 121 leads this period at $14.86 per lead — well below the $45 ceiling seen in July — so the paid campaign is doing its job. The problem is downstream: none of those leads have converted into active pipeline opportunities, meaning contacts are coming in but not being followed up through the system. SMS automation and a dedicated calling tool are both overdue and are the primary fixes being put in place to close that gap. On the organic side, Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply in the last week and a posting cadence was launched on September 30th to begin rebuilding that visibility. Next period, expect the pipeline to start filling as the automation pieces come online and retargeting gets underway.
